snippet.title: "Tsugunohi" PV for PlayStation®4
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10009911

■Release date: 2024/2/9 0:00 JST (*Subject to change slightly)
■Supported Languages: Japanese/English/Traditional Chinese/Simplified Chinese/Korean/Spanish

Over 100 million views of related videos.
The popular horror game "Tsugunohi" is now available on PlayStation®4.

■Includes 10 short stories, including the popular "Tsugunohi -The parallel train in the dark-".
■Newly added "Round 2" of "Tsugunohi -A Whisper from the Past-".

In addition, a new "Achievement Trophy" function has been added to the PlayStation®4 version.

■Trophies can be earned based on game progress and other factors.
■Linked to the discovery of hidden elements and additional elements in the "Round 2" of the game

The horror of the "erosion" of your daily life is now available for you to enjoy…

■Official website
https://www.gamemaga.jp/tsugunohi/
■Official Twitter
https://twitter.com/tsugunohi

©ImCyan / vaka, Inc.
